comment_regular: [Verified] The byte bAsyncGeometryDecalCreateGate_0B3A690 selects queued versus synchronous creation: nonzero attempts to pop/submit a BSTECreateTask; zero or failed submission dispatches BSTECreateTask_ReturnToPool if needed, then calls BSTempEffectGeometryDecal::Initialize synchronously. Initialization/writers of the gate remain Unknown.
